faq.title: My payment went through. Where is my receipt?
faq.problem_statement: Your payment is confirmed, but you cannot find the receipt or confirmation email.
faq.cause_explanation: In these cases, the email was in spam, arrived later, or needed to be resent after support verified the email address.
step_by_step_fix: Check your spam folder for the receipt and confirm its order reference.
Verify that the order or payment is confirmed. Ask support if you are unsure.
Allow for an email delay; a confirmation email can arrive after payment succeeds.
If the receipt is still missing, contact support to verify your email address and resend it.
edge_cases: A missing receipt alone is not a reason to repeat a confirmed payment.
faq.when_to_contact_support: Contact support if you cannot confirm the payment status or still need the receipt after checking spam and allowing for a delay.

records.case_summary: Payment succeeded, but the customer could not find the receipt.
records.resolution_text: Support located the receipt in the spam folder and confirmed its order reference.

records.case_summary: The order showed as paid while its confirmation email was delayed.
records.resolution_text: Support verified the payment and confirmed the email arrived later; no second payment was needed.

records.case_summary: Payment was confirmed, but the receipt email had not arrived.
records.resolution_text: Support verified the customer's email address and resent the receipt successfully.

records.case_summary: A password reset link expired before the customer could sign in.
records.resolution_text: Support requested a fresh reset email and the customer signed in using its link.

records.case_summary: A returned item was received but the refund had not appeared.
records.resolution_text: Support confirmed the refund had been issued and the customer later confirmed receiving it.

records.case_summary: Parcel tracking stopped updating after the package left the warehouse.
records.resolution_text: Support checked the carrier's latest scan and shared the current tracking status.
